terms.definition: A file produced by a build and stored for later use.
An amount of money billed to a customer account.
A short-lived credential that authorises an API request.

discouragedAliases.reason: The handbook uses the US spelling throughout.
Access is granted by short-lived tokens, never by a static key.

exceptions.definition: A property of matter that causes it to experience a force in an electromagnetic field.
exceptions.reason: The physics explainers use the electrostatic sense; the billing sense does not apply to them.
